Release-Date: 2025-06-04, security patched: 8.14.1-2+deb13u4
Protocols: dict file ftp ftps gopher gophers http https imap imaps ipfs ipns ldap ldaps mqtt pop3 pop3s rtmp rtsp scp sftp smb smbs smtp smtps telnet tftp ws wss

metadata.build_mode: Dart VM benchmark; native candidates release library where configured
metadata.protocol_profile: HTTP/2 over TLS; ALPN h2 verified

methodology.connection_reuse: candidate behavior is recorded; no reuse claim is inferred

timing_boundaries.upload_start: before file length/stat preparation for every candidate
timing_boundaries.upload_end: after response body completion and candidate/native cleanup notification
timing_boundaries.download_end: after response bytes are written and file sink closes
timing_boundaries.concurrency_start: before the first candidate future is created

methodology.upload_validation: server byte count plus deterministic FNV-1a 64 content hash
methodology.process_metrics: macOS ps CPU time/utilization plus Dart RSS/peak RSS; unavailable is reported explicitly
methodology.classification_rule: approximately equivalent <=5% p50 difference; clear >=20% with non-overlapping p25-p75 and <=10% CV; likely >=10% and <=20% CV; otherwise inconclusive

stream_metrics.queue_policy: native credit/ack window bounds FFI-delivered chunks
stream_metrics.pause_behavior: native response delivery waits for Dart chunk acknowledgments when credits are exhausted
